summary: npm package ships browser-only redirect payload served via CDN
details: px.js is a browser-only script that injects a full-screen iframe redirecting the visiting page to https://mfmz.qvsuy.cn/H.html?c=0gjr. The bundled update_px8my.sh indicates the package is published to npm for consumption through the jsDelivr CDN rather than as a Node library; the main entry references document/iframe and would throw under Node. No preinstall/postinstall lifecycle hooks and no top-level Node side effects are present, so `npm install` of this package does not by itself execute the redirect against the installing developer. Harm materializes only if the code is bundled into or fetched by a downstream web application, in which case that application's end-users would be redirected to the external site.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
